subject: Living-room storage around real routines
hook: From 'the remotes go missing' to a fitted unit
ig:
From 'the remotes always go missing' to a unit where they always end up in the same drawer.

This is how we work when someone asks for living-room storage:

We measure the alcove or wall, including sockets, skirting and the radiator.
We note what actually lives in the room. Not 'storage', but remotes, Lego, the games console, the board games.
We draw it in 3D so you can see where each thing goes before we cut a single panel.
Then it is built and assembled in our workshop in Hanley and fitted by our own team.

The result is storage with a job for every drawer, which is the only kind that stays tidy.

Start with a free design consultation via the link in bio.
fb:
"We just need more storage" is how a lot of living-room enquiries start. Our first question back is always: storage for what?

This short video shows how we work: measure the space, list what lives in it, draw it in 3D for you to check, then build it in our Hanley workshop. When every drawer has a job, the room stays tidy without much effort.
